%%| caption: A Stick Figure

\begin{tikzpicture}
  % Head
  \draw (0,0) circle (1cm);
  % Body
  \draw (0,-1) -- (0,-3);
  % Arms
  \draw (-1,-2) -- (0,-1) -- (1,-2);
  % Legs
  \draw (-1,-4) -- (0,-3) -- (1,-4);
\end{tikzpicture}
